description: Rejects removed generic row and collection skeleton recipes in app source and screen-local root title typography overrides.
reason: Covered by ci:flutter-workspace-analysis. It banned CatchSkeleton.rows, mediaRows, iconRows, cards, boxes and chips, and titleStyle on CatchLegacyTopBar.primaryRail. None of these exist in catch_ui any more, so any use is a compile error that analysis with --fatal-infos fails. Its allowances had been zero everywhere.
